meta.title: Agent swarm
meta.description: Adds one `swarm` tool that runs a whole plan of independent worker agents in parallel and merges their answers into a single report. Workers are ordinary subagents with their own context and tools; the swarm adds a concurrency ceiling, a retry budget, a whole-batch deadline, and per-task structured results so a fan-out is bounded and legible instead of a pile of separate delegations.
